Corpus outcomes cover each requested corpus; only a top-level corpus warning means results are partial and must be surfaced to the user. An optional corpus outcome of not-registered in a multi-corpus result is informational. If response has disabled=true or stale=true, tell the user and include the warning/action guidance.
